newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL-SWEDEN GROUP WINS SAO PAULO STATE CELL AREA.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL-SWEDEN GROUP WINS SAO PAULO STATE CELL AREA.

text.p: A group including Swedish telecoms firm Telia won bidding on a concession to operate B Band area cellular services in Brazil's Sao Paulo state, a Communications Ministry official said Friday.
The Tess group, which also includes Airline Celular of Brazil and Primave, part of local construction group C.R. Alameida, won the 15-year concession when it bid 1.326 billion reais.
The bid was more than double the government's minimum price of 600 million reais for the B Band area No.2 concession.
The Tess group's offer of a 121-percent premium beat out bids from four other consortia.
The ministry was due later Friday morning to open the bids for B Band area 10, covering six northeastern state.
